verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents a REST API at /rest/v0 with an OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec, a ReadMe reference and a sandbox. The vendor itself says the API is still under development, with endpoints being added, and that it was built for platform-to-platform integrations rather than as a full mirror of the UI. missing for 10: any evidence of UI-to-API parity, endpoint coverage for UI features such as invoicing, reconciliation, AI Close, rules and batch categorization, self-serve API access, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Puzzle publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 document
Our API is currently under development. We will be continually adding new features and endpoints
Our API was originally architected for deep platform-to-platform integrations.
